high_level_description: The image features a textured concrete wall as the background. The wall has a rough, industrial appearance with visible specks and imperfections, suggesting it is made of concrete or a similar material. The surface is uneven, with some areas appearing smoother than others. Overlaid on the concrete wall is a block of text in bold, black font. The text reads: "Human civilisation has become a giant concrete machine. Everything else is just a by-product." The quote is presented in a straightforward, sans-serif typeface, which contrasts sharply with the rough texture of the concrete behind it.
